question: Should Twilio RCS be maintained as a bundled OpenClaw channel or distributed as an external channel plugin through ClawHub?
rationale: The implementation uses existing plugin seams, but bundling an optional commercial channel creates permanent configuration, security, dependency, documentation, and support ownership that repository policy leaves to maintainers.

options.title: External ClawHub plugin
options.body: Keep the implementation plugin-owned in a separate repository and publish it through ClawHub after correcting Twilio contracts and adding live proof.

options.title: Sponsor bundled channel
options.body: Accept ongoing core ownership, then require contract fixes, live fresh-install and coexistence proof, dependency authorization, and upgrade documentation before merge.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Keep the linked feature discussion open but stop investing in this branch until demand or an ownership sponsor changes the cost-benefit balance.

recommendation.title: External ClawHub plugin
recommendation.body: Keep the implementation plugin-owned in a separate repository and publish it through ClawHub after correcting Twilio contracts and adding live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The closest product and implementation precedent is the bundled Twilio SMS channel introduced through their merged work.
